title: {{app}} accounts
closeToCapture: Close the app first: it rewrites its session file while running, so a capture taken now could be half-written.
notSignedIn: {{app}} has not been signed in on this computer yet. Sign in there once, close it, then save the account here.
explain: VibeHub never reads your {{app}} token. An account is a sealed copy of the session file the app keeps; switching closes the app, backs up the current session, writes the saved one and reopens the app.
warnNotPortable: Saved accounts only work on this Windows account on this computer. The app encrypts its session with a key that never leaves this machine.
warnSharedFile: The session file also holds unrelated state (other providers, workspace keys, bot settings). Restoring an older copy rolls that state back too — that is why a backup is taken before every switch.
warnVerifyInApp: VibeHub only verifies that the file was written correctly. Open {{app}} and confirm the account actually changed.
sessionChanged: {{app}} rewrote its session after your last switch or capture — most likely you signed in with another account. That account is not saved yet; switching will back it up first, and it stays recoverable only through that backup.
emptyHint: Sign in inside {{app}}, close it, then use “Save the current account”. You can then sign in with a second account, save that too, and switch between them.
revertConfirm: The last backup is written back over the current session. The app must be closed. Your current session is backed up first, so this is reversible.
deleteConfirm: This saved account is removed from VibeHub. The account currently inside the app is not changed.
browserTitle: Real {{app}} accounts are available in the desktop app
browserHint: This browser preview cannot read the session file or the Windows credential vault.

notices.switched: Account switched. Open the app and confirm the account changed.

errors.closeRequired: Close the app first and try again.
errors.machineMismatch: This saved account was captured on a different machine, so it cannot be restored here.
errors.loginRequired: No session file found. Sign in inside the app first.
errors.switchFailed: The session file did not verify after writing, so the previous state was restored.
errors.rollbackFailed: Writing failed and restoring the backup also failed. Use “Restore last backup” or sign in again.
errors.credentialInvalid: The saved account data is unusable. Delete the account and save it again.
errors.busy: Another account operation is already running.
errors.tooMany: At most 16 accounts can be saved.
errors.unknownAccount: That saved account no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.invalidName: Enter a name between 1 and 120 characters.
errors.vault: The Windows credential vault is unavailable, so the saved account cannot be decrypted.
errors.storage: Reading or writing the account data failed.
errors.noBackup: There is no backup to restore yet.
errors.unsupportedApp: Accounts are not supported for this app.
errors.requestFailed: The operation did not complete. Try again.
